per_candidate.id: s2:Introducing MEGASIM: Multitudinous Earth Greek/Trojan Asteroid SIMulation

rationale: Paper 2505.07937 investigates the asymmetrical gas distribution near the co-orbital Lagrange points of an embedded planet, which directly relates to the mechanisms of Trojan formation in a viscous gaseous environment. This contributes substantive new evidence on part of the question.
